theory_low.arthur-qubo-equivalence-condition: Section III, after Eq. 16, p.2-3: the penalty derivation is shown but 'large enough' is not quantified and the equivalence is asserted without a proof. An informal argument, not a proved result.
theory_low.arthur-balanced-reduction: Section III, Eqs. 2-4, p.2: the rewrite by the law of total variance is stated without derivation; the balanced reduction is trivial but the identity is asserted, not proved here.
theory_low.arthur-qubit-count-footprint: Section IV-A, p.4: the O(N^2 k^2) qubit footprint rests on a cited embedding algorithm [30]; no derivation in the paper.
theory_low.arthur-quantum-complexity: Section IV-A, Eq. 19, p.4-5: an informal operation count that rests on the assumption of constant annealing time. Not a theorem.
theory_low.quantum-example-from-membership-query: Section 3.2, p.7: a one-line construction in prose, not a stated and proved theorem.
theory_low.greedy-learner-query-bound: Section 4.1, p.9: an informal sketch of the greedy argument; the bound is then attributed to [BCG+96] as Theorem 4.2. Not proved in the paper.
theory_low.linear-function-fourier-sampling: Section 5.3, p.18: a short prose argument; the classical Omega(n) bound is argued informally and no proof is given.
theory_low.qlt-gamma-greedy-algorithm: Section 4.1, p.9: an informal sketch of the greedy bound; attributed to [BCG+96] as Theorem 4.2 right after. Not proved here.
theory_low.qlt-thm-4-3-proof-adversary: Section 4.1.1, p.9-10: a proof sketch of a cited theorem [SG04] that relies on Ambainis's adversary bound; the cases are outlined, not proved.
theory_low.qlt-thm-4-3-proof-holevo: Section 4.1.1, p.10: a proof sketch of a cited theorem [SG04] that uses Holevo's theorem; informal.
theory_low.qlt-thm-4-6-proof-basic-algorithm: Section 4.1.2, p.11: a sketch of a cited theorem; the basic algorithm does not reach the stated bound and the rest is omitted.
theory_low.qlt-thm-4-6-proof-final-algorithm: Section 4.1.2, p.12: a sketch that uses Lemma 4.7 from [Heg95] and Kothari's optimization result as cited facts. Not proved here.
theory_low.qlt-quantum-upper-bound-trivial: Section 4.2, p.13: an elementary observation stated without proof, plus a forward pointer; not a stated and proved result.
theory_low.qlt-thm-4-12-proof-sketch: Section 4.2, p.13-14: a proof sketch; Theorem 4.13 is cited and explicitly not proved ('We will not prove this') and the d-independent part is omitted.
theory_low.qlt-thm-4-15-proof-sketch: Section 4.3, p.14-15: a proof sketch that relies on the cited Theorem 4.13 [AW17]; the easy part is omitted.
theory_low.qlt-thm-4-16-proof-fat-shattering: Section 4.4, p.16: a proof sketch of a cited theorem; it relies on results of Anthony-Bartlett, Bartlett-Long and Aaronson.
theory_low.qlt-dnf-quantum-proof-idea: Section 5.2, p.18: the survey says the full algorithm is beyond its scope; Theorem 5.3 is cited from [BJ99]; only an idea is sketched.
theory_low.qlt-linear-functions-fourier-sampling: Section 5.3, p.18-19: a short prose argument; the classical Omega(n) lower bound is argued informally and no proof is given.
theory_low.qlt-thm-5-4-proof-sketch: Section 5.3, p.19: a proof sketch of Theorem 5.4 cited from [AS09]; the sketch is informal and the details are not given.
